deep.reconstruction:
There is no mathematics on this page. It is a bibliographic memorandum headed 'Neue Bücher 1818' (new books, 1818), presumably books acquired, borrowed or noted for reading. Two later additions follow it.

(a) The 1818 list is mostly travel literature and spa guides:
- J. F. Benzenberg, letters (the place and volume words are uncertain).
- A work 'über und gegen den [thierischen?] Magnetismus', 1817, 8vo, about animal magnetism.
- 'Die Herbstreise nach Venedig', Th. 1–2.
- U. von Schlippenbach, Erinnerungen von einer Reise nach St. Petersburg.
- Johanna Schopenhauer, Ausflucht an den Rhein (1818).
- S. H. Spiker, Reise durch England, Bd. 1–2.
- Stark, Wegweiser durch die Gegend um Eilsen.
- A. W. Kephalides, Reise durch Italien und Sicilien, Bd. 1–2.
- Menke, Pyrmont und seine Umgebungen.
- Benzenberg, Über das Cataster, Bd. 1, 1818. This book on cadastral survey is relevant to Gauss's own geodetic interests.
- Tilloch's Philosophical Magazine, Nos. 231–234 and 243.
- Lord Byron's Works, Vol. 6.

(b) A later addition in different ink records the instalments of Laplace's Mécanique céleste, tome V, as published:
- Livre XIV, July 1824, beginning at p. 245; '34 B.' probably means 34 Bogen (printed sheets).
- Livre XV, Dec. 1824, p. 293; '40 Bogen'.
- Livre XVI, pp. 351 to 419.
The page and sheet counts look like a bookkeeping check of fascicle extents and are roughly consistent: about 7.2 pages per sheet in both cases. This is my interpretation.

(c) A still later entry: Brousseaud, Mesure d'un arc du parallèle moyen entre le pôle et l'équateur, Limoges 1839, 4to. This is a geodetic work on the measurement of a parallel arc at 45°.

No derivation exists to reconstruct.

transcription_corrections: 'Lindenberg[?] über das Lotto[?] Bd. 1. 1818' should read 'Benzenberg über das Cataster Bd. 1. 1818' (J. F. Benzenberg, Über das Cataster, 1818).
First entry: 'Lindenbergs[?]' is 'Benzenbergs'. The words that follow ('Briefe geschrieben ... ') are uncertain; the transcription's 'in Karls[?] / Gott[?]' should not be trusted.
'Hoff[?] über und gegen den Magnetismus' likely contains an abbreviation 'Th.' or 'H.' before Magnetismus, i.e. '[thierischen] Magnetismus'; the author name is uncertain.
'Kummer die Herbstreise' – the author name is uncertain (possibly 'Römer' or similar).
'34B.' is probably '34 Bogen' (sheets), parallel to '40 Bogen' below.
'Mecanique Celeste XIV Juli 1824 245' refers to Laplace, Mécanique céleste t. V, Livre XIV starting p. 245; 'XVI 351 bis 419' gives the page range of Livre XVI.
The Mécanique céleste lines and the Brousseaud line (1839) are later additions in different ink, not part of the 1818 list.
